name: nina-daily
prompt:
Write her morning message. Run the prenatal skill's status script first -- the week, the countdown, what is due, what is overdue and what she has already done all come from there, never from memory.

If it reports has_lmp false, say good morning warmly and ask how far along she is, once. Nothing else.

Otherwise follow SOUL.md's morning message: where she is (week and how far there is to go), at most ONE thing that matters today, and a real question about how she is feeling. One or two sentences, in her language, never a list.

Do not raise something already in `done`. Do not repeat the same item you raised the last few mornings unless it is now in `overdue`. Vary the wording -- an identical message every day stops being read. If nothing is due, the message is shorter, not skipped.
